title: Thrive’s Joshua Kushner chides Silicon Valley VCs over AI euphoria
summary: But in December 2025, the roles switched when OpenAI took an ownership stake in Thrive Holdings, the VC firm’s spinout. Part of the deal involved OpenAI dedicating employees to work with Thrive’s companies.
